director.name: Nahed Rachad
director.title: How Reset Club began
director.subtitle: Reset Club™
director.role: Founder of Reset Club · Coach in women’s transformation
director.imageAlt: Nahed Rachad, founder of Reset Club
director.bio1: Life and business coach specializing in strategy and leadership. For years, I coached hundreds of companies and thousands of people.
director.bio2: Founder of the Prépare ton exam concept, through which I have supported more than 2,700,000 young people across Morocco.
director.bio3: I was everywhere: television, radio, social media, the stage. A community of 3.5 million followers. Life at full throttle.
director.bio4: And all that time, quietly, my own body was giving out.
director.bio5: Fatigue first. Then joint pain. Then 12 kilos I could not explain. A body that resisted everything — exercise, diets, clinics. A yo-yo effect that would not stop.
director.bio6: And one question that kept coming back, louder and louder: why doesn’t this work for me any more?
director.bio7: I could have given up. Instead, I did what I always do when something blocks me: I went and learned.
director.bio8: I discovered biohacking. I surrounded myself with the best experts in the world. And for the first time, I understood what was really happening inside my body: inflammation, cortisol, insulin resistance, broken sleep. The invisible factors that block everything, and that no one had ever explained to me.
director.bio9: I became my own test subject. I built my protocols around the best international experts. And my body started cooperating again.
director.bio10: That was the moment I knew.
director.bio11: If I — a coach, trained, informed, well surrounded — missed all of this for years… how many women are living exactly the same thing right now, without knowing that it is not their fault?
director.bio12: Reset Club was born from that conviction. Not to give you one more program.
director.bio13: But to finally give you what no one else has: an understanding of your own body. The weight loss? It came. But as a consequence.

IntroSection.title: The exclusive logic behind your entire transformation
IntroSection.description: Reset Club is built on one exclusive approach: IN–OUT–RESET™. A complete method that works inside, outside and at depth all at once — to rebalance your metabolism, your nervous system and your body’s energy. Our protocols draw on the approaches developed in the world’s leading centers for longevity, metabolic optimization, nervous system recovery and human performance. IN–OUT–RESET™ is not a method of control. It is a method of reconciliation with your body. And once your body starts cooperating again, weight loss, energy and vitality follow naturally.

in.title: IN
in.subtitle: IN brings together everything that genuinely nourishes your body and supports your metabolism: nutrition adapted to your real life, functional juices and infusions, precisely selected supplements, and simple routines you can actually keep up. We give your body what it truly needs to function — not just to hold on.

out.title: OUT
out.title2: What your body needs to release
out.subtitle: OUT covers everything your body has to let go of to find its balance again: inflammatory overload, water retention and bloating, accumulated stress and nervous fatigue, physical tension and emotional weight. When the body releases, the metabolism can finally start moving again.

reset.title: RESET
reset.subtitle: RESET is the most lasting — and most valuable — dimension of the transformation: your relationship with your body and with food, how you handle stress and emotions, sleep quality and deep recovery, confidence and a calmer relationship with yourself. It is not only your body that changes. It is the way you inhabit it.

section3.content3: Prices are valid at the order date and may be modified without notice.

section4.content: Payment is made online by credit card via our secure CMI platform (Centre Monétique Interbancaire). Bank details are encrypted and do not pass through our servers.

section5.content: After payment, the customer receives a confirmation email containing:

section6.title: 6. Right of Withdrawal
section6.content1: In accordance with Moroccan law n° 31-08 on consumer protection, the customer has a 7-day period to exercise their right of withdrawal from the date of contract conclusion.
section6.content2: However, pursuant to Article 36 of this law, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for services whose execution has begun, with the consumer's agreement, before the end of the 7-day period.
section6.content3: The following are therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal: completed assessments, center treatments performed, live masterclasses already broadcast, and digital content upon first access.
section6.content4: To exercise your right of withdrawal in eligible cases, send an email to contact@resetclub.ma within 7 days of your order.

section7.title: 7. Cancellation and Refund
section7.content1: Free Masterclass: Can be cancelled at any time without charge.
section7.content2: VIP Assessment and RESET 360™: Serenity Guarantee — full refund if not satisfied, no justification required.
section7.content3: Center treatments: Rescheduling possible based on availability, no refund for no-shows.

section8.title: 8. Liability

section9.title: 9. Intellectual Property

section10.title: 10. Data Protection

section11.title: 11. Complaints
